description: Implementation of the Hypergeometric distribution class, providing statistical methods, probability calculations, and distribution parameters.

classes.name: HypergeometricDistribution
classes.description: Class representing the hypergeometric distribution with methods to compute probabilities, distribution parameters, and statistical metrics.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates cumulative probability P(X <= x) for the distribution.

methods.name: getDomain
methods.description: Returns the lower and upper bounds for the distribution based on parameters.

methods.name: getLowerDomain
methods.description: Computes the minimum value of the support for given parameters.

methods.name: getNumberOfSuccesses
methods.description: Accessor for the number of successes in the population.

methods.name: getPopulationSize
methods.description: Accessor for the total population size.

methods.name: getUpperDomain
methods.description: Computes the maximum possible value of the support for given parameters.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability mass function at x.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Calculates the logarithm of the probability at x.

methods.name: upperCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates P(X > x) or upper tail probability.

methods.name: innerCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Sums probabilities in the specified range based on direction.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution, using cached value if available.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution support.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution support.

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether the support of the distribution is connected.
